decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable hydration backpack for hiking. While there are several budget-friendly options in the feed, such as the INOXTO and Lunidry packs, multiple reviews point to significant quality issues like leaking bladders and unraveling fabric. The USWE Hajker is a high-quality technical pack, but at over $200 with very few reviews, it is too high of a risk for me today. The cooler backpack also has reports of sweating and leaking. I have decided to hold off on a purchase until I can find a pack with more consistent durability ratings.
